pronunciation.note: 重点辨认 ph 的发音；教材 Sound 例词以 photography 为核心，并在句子中出现 phone、elephant。

wordForms.examTip: 注意词义和词性不同，不能把 photography 当作“照片”。

wordForms.forms: paint v. 画；painting n. 画作
wordForms.examTip: Look, this is Xiaopu's painting. 中 painting 是名词。
Story time 中 draw the leaves，常考特殊复数。
Taking photos 作单数主语，所以用 helps。
How about 后若表达“加入”，应用 joining。

examPoints.point: be going to 中 be 的选择
examPoints.example: Which club ___ you going to join?

examPoints.point: How about 后的动词形式

examPoints.example: Bamboo is one of the four noble ___ (plant).
Taking photos ___ (help) me keep sweet moments.

examPoints.point: join / take part in 的语境
examPoints.example: I am going to ___ the Photography Club.

examPoints.point: 社团名称、时间、地点和选择理由
examPoints.example: 根据 Fun time 表格匹配 club / day / room。

transformations.from: I'm going to join the Photography Club.
transformations.to: What club are you going to join?
transformations.point: 对社团名称提问用 What club。
How about 与 What about 可作同义建议表达。

transformations.from: Taking photos helps me keep the sweet moments.
transformations.to: It is helpful to take photos to keep sweet moments.
transformations.point: 理解 V-ing 作主语与 It is + adj. + to do 的表达转换。

writing.topic: My club / My photo journal in a club
structure: 再写在社团里做什么/学到什么
useful: In the ... Club, I learn how to ...
